verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows AgentMail letting a user share availability or insert bookable meeting times into an email. The only related item is one mention that the hosted MCP server exposes "calendar tools" (agentmail-docs-54), with no detail on what they do. Other versions of the same MCP doc (docs-12, docs-23) omit calendar entirely, so this is an adjacent feature at best and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
